verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Go SDK's GetTldListWithContext call, which lists all TLDs and their per-TLD API capabilities. That implies a TLD catalog with some per-TLD metadata, but nothing in the pack establishes its breadth or documents special requirements. Missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of supported extensions, per-TLD documentation of restricted-TLD and country-code registration requirements, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of TLD coverage.
